content:
This is a gun pack for "Timeless and Classic Guns: Zero", adds Firearms inspired by the game "Ready or Not" made by Void Interactive.

 

Non Mod version: [TaCZ] Weapons and Tactics

From 0.3.1 on, TaCZ 1.1.8 is REQUIRED!

Available now

Very Important, this Project will be the Mod-version. And the other is the ZIP-version of this Project!!!

 

Trailer

Showcase (Old)

Showcase (New)


Thx for 475k Downloads!

 

What does it add?

Currently it adds:

48 Guns:

(590M Shotgun

LVAR

M32A1

M1014

MK17

MK-V

MP5A2

P99

TRPL

B1301

...)


13 Attachments:

(4 Grips

3 Laser

2 Muzzle

3 Sights

1 Stock)

 

9 Ammo types:

(.68 Pepperball

.300 Blackout

6.5x48 Creedmoor

7.62x51mm

10mm

Bean Bag

Frangible Slug

Trainings 9mm

Trainings 5.56x45mm)

 

(endless ammo version comming with v1.0)

 

How to install：

Just click Install and choose your instance. Then the version will be downloaded automatically
